text: {"sql":"SELECT p.name AS product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE o.status = '已完成' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 10","unanswerable":false,"unanswerableReason":""}
